mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear night near the Verona Area High School with a temperature of 39 degrees. We are currently seeing a New Moon, and you can expect an overnight low of 38 degrees with no rain predicted.

For our city news, please be advised that asphalt pavement repairs are planned for November 10 and 11. Crews will be milling and patching various streets including Morningside Boulevard and Todd Street. Parking will be restricted in these areas from 7 AM to 7 PM.

There is plenty to do in town over the next couple of days. Tomorrow, you can catch live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead to November 11, we have trivia nights at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus pizza and a pitcher specials at Wisconsin Brewing Company.

In our weekly police report, on October 25, officers were dispatched to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they located a 40-year-old man passed out behind the wheel; he was subsequently arrested for O W I.

Today's flavor of the day was Really Reese's. Please note that the store is now closed for the night. We look forward to seeing you tomorrow at 10 AM when we will be featuring the Snickers Swirl as our flavor of the day.
